title: The Silent Patient
description: A renowned painter shoots her husband and then never speaks another word. A criminal psychotherapist becomes fixated on breaking her silence and uncovering the truth, in a tense, twist-driven psychological thriller with an unreliable narrator.

title: Gone Girl
description: When a woman vanishes on her fifth wedding anniversary, suspicion falls on her husband. Told through shifting, unreliable perspectives, it is a sharp, cynical thriller about a marriage built on lies and the stories we tell to survive.

title: Sharp Objects
description: A troubled reporter returns to her stifling hometown to cover the murders of two girls and is forced to confront her own damaged family. A dark, atmospheric thriller about inherited violence and buried trauma.

title: The Woman in the Window
description: An agoraphobic woman who spends her days watching her neighbors believes she has witnessed a crime, but no one trusts her account. A claustrophobic, Hitchcockian thriller with an unreliable narrator.

title: Before I Go to Sleep
description: A woman wakes each morning with no memory of the past, piecing her life together from a journal she cannot remember writing. A tense thriller about memory, trust, and the fragility of identity.

title: In the Woods
description: A detective investigates the murder of a child in the same woods where, decades earlier, he survived a disappearance he cannot recall. A literary, atmospheric crime novel about memory and the unknowable past.

title: The Guest List
description: A glamorous wedding on a remote island turns deadly when a guest is found murdered and everyone has something to hide. A twisty, multi-narrator mystery in the classic closed-circle tradition.

title: Big Little Lies
description: Three mothers in a seaside town are drawn together by their children and pulled apart by secrets, building toward a death at a school fundraiser. A sharp, darkly funny novel about the lies behind picture-perfect lives.

title: And Then There Were None
description: Ten strangers are lured to an isolated island and killed off one by one, each accused of a hidden crime. The archetypal closed-circle mystery and one of the best-selling novels of all time.

title: The Cuckoo's Calling
description: A war-veteran private detective investigates the apparent suicide of a supermodel that her brother insists was murder. A richly plotted contemporary detective novel and the start of the Cormoran Strike series.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
description: A disgraced journalist and a brilliant, antisocial hacker investigate a wealthy family's decades-old disappearance. A dark Scandinavian crime thriller about corruption, violence, and justice.

title: The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency
description: Botswana's first female private detective opens an agency and solves her neighbors' small mysteries with warmth and shrewd common sense. A gentle, charming series steeped in the landscape and life of Botswana.

title: Normal People
description: Two young people in Ireland circle each other across years, school, and university, bound by an intense, often painful connection. A spare, intimate literary novel about love, power, and miscommunication.

title: A Little Life
description: Four college friends build their adult lives in New York, their bond increasingly defined by one man's unspeakable past. An immersive, devastating literary novel about trauma, friendship, and endurance.

title: The Secret History
description: A group of elite classics students at a New England college are drawn into a murder that corrodes them from within. The defining dark-academia novel, a brooding study of beauty, obsession, and guilt.

title: The Goldfinch
description: A boy who survives a bombing at an art museum clings to a famous painting as his life spirals through loss and the criminal underworld. A sprawling, Dickensian literary novel about grief, art, and chance.

title: Beloved
description: A formerly enslaved woman is haunted, literally and figuratively, by the daughter she lost and the past she cannot escape. A towering, lyrical novel about slavery, memory, and the cost of freedom.

title: Never Let Me Go
description: Students at a secluded English boarding school slowly discover the terrible purpose their lives were created to serve. A restrained, heartbreaking novel that uses quiet science fiction to meditate on mortality and love.

title: The Remains of the Day
description: An aging English butler reflects on a lifetime of service and the love and convictions he sacrificed to it. A quietly devastating novel about dignity, regret, and a life measured too late.

title: Klara and the Sun
themes: what it means to be human
description: An artificial friend observes the human world with tender, careful attention as she is chosen to care for an ailing child. A gentle, philosophical novel about love, sacrifice, and what makes us human.

title: The Name of the Wind
description: A legendary, now-hidden hero recounts the story of his life: a gifted, grieving boy's rise through a university of magic. A beautifully written epic fantasy about music, loss, and the gap between legend and truth.

title: A Game of Thrones
description: Noble houses scheme, betray, and go to war for a kingdom's throne while an ancient threat gathers in the north. A sprawling, ruthless epic fantasy famous for its political intrigue and morally grey characters.

title: The Way of Kings
description: On a storm-scoured world, a slave, a scholar, and a reluctant warrior are drawn toward an ancient power as civilization teeters. A massive, intricately built epic fantasy and the start of the Stormlight Archive.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
description: A street thief with rare powers joins a crew plotting to overthrow an immortal god-emperor. A propulsive epic fantasy built on a clever, rule-based magic system and a daring heist structure.

title: The Hobbit
description: A comfort-loving hobbit is swept into a quest to reclaim a dwarf kingdom from a dragon. The warm, adventurous fantasy that opened the door to Middle-earth.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A hobbit inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with an unlikely fellowship to destroy it. The foundational epic fantasy of the modern genre.

title: The Night Circus
description: Two young magicians bound by a mysterious competition fall in love inside a wondrous circus that appears only at night. A lush, dreamlike fantasy prized for its atmosphere and imagery.

title: Piranesi
description: A man lives alone in an infinite labyrinth of tide-swept halls and statues, keeping a careful journal, until he begins to suspect the truth about his world. A spare, haunting, puzzle-like fantasy about memory and selfhood.

title: The Priory of the Orange Tree
description: Across a divided world, queens, mages, and dragonriders race to prevent the return of an ancient wyrm. A standalone epic fantasy with a sweeping, feminist cast and rich worldbuilding.

title: Circe
description: The overlooked witch-goddess of Greek myth comes into her own power across centuries of gods, monsters, and mortals. A lyrical, feminist retelling that gives a minor myth a luminous inner life.

title: The Song of Achilles
description: The Trojan War is retold through the tender, doomed love between Achilles and Patroclus. A lush, emotional mythological romance that builds to inevitable tragedy.

title: Dune
description: On a desert planet prized for a reality-bending spice, a young heir is swept into prophecy, politics, and revolution. The landmark epic of science fiction, dense with ecology, religion, and power.

title: The Three-Body Problem
description: A secret military project reaches out to the stars and receives an answer that will change humanity's fate, beginning against the backdrop of China's Cultural Revolution. A cerebral, ambitious hard-SF epic of first contact.

title: Project Hail Mary
description: A lone astronaut wakes with amnesia on a desperate mission to save Earth and finds help from an unexpected source. A warm, inventive hard-SF adventure driven by science, wit, and an unlikely friendship.

title: The Martian
description: Stranded alone on Mars, an astronaut must science his way to survival while Earth scrambles to bring him home. A funny, nail-biting survival story grounded in real engineering.

title: Neuromancer
description: A burned-out hacker is hired for one last job that drags him into a plot orchestrated by an artificial intelligence. The novel that defined cyberpunk, all neon, data, and noir.

title: Ancillary Justice
description: Once the mind of a warship inhabiting many bodies, now trapped in a single one, a soldier pursues revenge against the ruler of an empire. An inventive space opera that reimagines identity, gender, and consciousness.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
description: An envoy to an icebound world where people have no fixed gender must navigate its politics and his own assumptions. A profound, humane work of anthropological science fiction.

title: Recursion
description: A detective and a neuroscientist chase a technology that lets people revisit their memories, with reality unraveling in its wake. A propulsive, mind-bending science-fiction thriller about memory and time.

title: Dark Matter
description: A physics professor is abducted into a version of his life he never chose and must fight across parallel worlds to get home. A fast, high-concept thriller about the roads not taken.

title: The Love Hypothesis
description: A PhD student fake-dates a notoriously grumpy professor to convince her best friend she has moved on, and the pretense gets complicated. A witty, swoony contemporary romance set in academic science with great banter.

title: Beach Read
description: A burned-out romance writer and a literary novelist, stuck in neighboring beach houses, dare each other to swap genres. A warm, funny romance with real emotional depth beneath the banter.

title: People We Meet on Vacation
description: Two best friends with opposite personalities take one more summer trip to repair a friendship that may be something more. A sunny, tender friends-to-lovers romance full of humor and longing.

title: Red, White & Royal Blue
description: The American president's son and a British prince go from tabloid rivals to secret lovers. A joyful, funny, optimistic queer romance with sparkling banter.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: A quick-witted young woman and a proud, wealthy gentleman misjudge each other before love overturns their pride. The witty, enduring classic of the enemies-to-lovers romance.

title: All the Light We Cannot See
description: A blind French girl and a German boy soldier are drawn together by fate in occupied France during World War II. A luminous, finely crafted historical novel about courage and small acts of grace.

title: The Book Thief
description: In Nazi Germany, a girl steals books and shares them while her foster family hides a Jewish man, narrated by Death itself. A tender, inventive novel about words, loss, and humanity amid horror.

title: Pachinko
description: Four generations of a Korean family endure poverty, prejudice, and displacement across twentieth-century Korea and Japan. A sweeping, deeply human family saga about belonging and survival.

title: The Nightingale
description: Two sisters in occupied France take different, dangerous paths of resistance during World War II. An emotional historical novel about the courage of ordinary women in wartime.

title: Homegoing
description: Two half-sisters in Ghana are set on divergent fates, one married off and one sold into slavery, their descendants traced across three centuries. A powerful generational saga about the long shadow of slavery.

title: The Shadow of the Wind
description: In postwar Barcelona, a boy discovers a forgotten novel and sets out to find its author, only to learn someone is destroying every copy of his books. An atmospheric, gothic literary mystery and a love letter to reading.

title: Wolf Hall
description: The rise of Thomas Cromwell from blacksmith's son to the most powerful adviser in Henry VIII's England. A dense, brilliant historical novel about power, loyalty, and survival at court.

title: The Shining
description: A troubled writer takes a winter caretaking job at an isolated hotel that preys on his family and his sanity. A classic of psychological horror about isolation, addiction, and a malevolent place.

title: Mexican Gothic
description: A glamorous young socialite travels to a decaying mansion in the Mexican countryside to rescue her cousin and uncovers its horrifying secret. A lush, creeping gothic horror thick with dread and atmosphere.

title: The Haunting of Hill House
description: Four people gather to investigate a house with a sinister reputation, and one fragile woman begins to feel it claim her. A masterful, ambiguous ghost story that works entirely on psychological dread.

title: The Midnight Library
description: Between life and death lies a library where a despairing woman can try the lives she might have lived. A warm, philosophical novel about regret, possibility, and learning to value the life you have.

title: A Man Called Ove
description: A rigid, grumpy widower's plans are repeatedly interrupted by the noisy neighbors who slowly pull him back into life. A funny, tender novel about grief, community, and unexpected second chances.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
description: A girl abandoned to raise herself in the marshes of North Carolina becomes a murder suspect when a local man is found dead. A lyrical blend of coming-of-age story, nature writing, and courtroom mystery.

title: Educated
description: Raised by survivalist parents who kept her out of school, the author claws her way to education and, eventually, a doctorate. A gripping memoir about family, loyalty, and the transformative, costly power of learning.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
description: A sweeping account of how one unremarkable ape came to dominate the planet through stories, money, and belief. A provocative, accessible big-history book about what made humans human.

title: The Kite Runner
description: A privileged boy in Kabul betrays his loyal friend and spends his life seeking a way to atone, against the backdrop of Afghanistan's upheavals. An emotional novel about guilt, friendship, and redemption.

In a totalitarian superstate that monitors everything, a low-ranking worker risks everything for forbidden thought and love. The defining dystopian novel about surveillance, propaganda, and the control of truth.

title: Brave New World
description: A future society engineers happiness through conditioning, drugs, and the abolition of want, until an outsider questions the cost. A chilling dystopia about comfort traded for freedom.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
description: In a theocratic regime that has stripped women of their rights, a handmaid kept for childbearing remembers the world she lost. A harrowing feminist dystopia about control, complicity, and survival.
